Why do these polymers last for so long?

intelligence.enrichment: Concentration is the amount of solute present in a fixed quantity of solution or solvent; for the same fixed quantity, more dissolved solute means a more concentrated solution and less dissolved solute means a more dilute solution. Increasing the dissolved solute amount for a fixed quantity increases concentration; decreasing it lowers concentration. The learner correctly applies this rule: Concentration is the amount of solute present in a fixed quantity of solution or solvent; for the same fixed quantity, more dissolved solute means a more concentrated solution and less dissolved solute means a more dilute solution. The solution with more spoons is always more concentrated, even if the water amount changes.
